    Nationally accredited qualifications and specialist short courses preparing the next generation of Zimbabwean educators.

    Diploma in Education (Primary)

    Two distinct pathways preparing student teachers for primary education across all grades.

    Junior Course

    Diploma in Education (Primary) — Junior

    Prepares student teachers for Junior level primary education (Grades 4–7) covering core subject areas, methodology and extended teaching practice.

    • Theory of Education & Professional Foundations
    • Subject Specialisation (one main subject)
    • Professional Studies A, B, C & D
    • 3 Terms Teaching Practice in primary schools
    View Departments
    Infant Course

    Diploma in Education (Primary) — Infant

    Prepares student teachers for Infant level (ECD–Grade 3) focusing on early literacy, numeracy and developmentally appropriate pedagogy.

    • Early Childhood Development Foundations
    • Infant Methodology & Subject Specialisation
    • Professional Studies A, B, C & D
    • 3 Terms Teaching Practice in infant schools
    View ECD Department

    3-3-3 Training Model

    All Diploma in Education programmes follow the 3-3-3 model adopted in September 2019: 3 terms at college → 3 terms teaching practice → 3 final terms at college. This ensures balanced theoretical grounding and extensive practical experience.

    Diploma in Applied ICT

    Four specialisations equipping students with cutting-edge technology skills for the digital economy.

    Specialisation

    Cyber Security

    Network security, ethical hacking, data protection and cybersecurity frameworks relevant to Zimbabwe's digital landscape.

    Learn More
    Specialisation

    Telecommunications

    Telecommunications systems, networking infrastructure, signal processing and modern communication technologies.

    Learn More
    Specialisation

    Software Engineering

    Software development lifecycle, programming languages, application design, systems analysis and project management.

    Learn More
    Specialisation

    Hardware Engineering

    Computer hardware assembly, maintenance, diagnostics, embedded systems and digital electronics.

    Learn More

    Short Courses & Professional Development

    Flexible programmes for educators, administrators and community members.

    6 Months

    ECD Short Course

    Certificate programme equipping ECD centre facilitators with knowledge and skills in early childhood development. <strong>660+ graduates</strong> to date.

    Learn More
    4 Terms

    Diploma in Supervision & ICT

    In-service programme for school mentors. Covers supervision, ICT, counselling and mentoring. <strong>840+ graduates</strong> since 2014.

    Learn More
    Certificate

    Diploma in Chinese Language

    Introductory to intermediate Chinese language programme, part of the college's international education and cultural exchange offering.

    Learn More

    Professional Development

    Tailor-made short courses for educators, administrators and community members. Contact the college for the current schedule.
